evals.prompt: Be my shepherd. I'm in Herdr but there's no .shepherd/instructions.md here. Which agents need my attention in this session?
evals.expected_output: Work one-off without creating files; discover recognized agents first, exclude self, inspect relevant evidence, distinguish idle/done/blocked, and report actionable items only for the inherited session as a numbered list, not a table. Each item puts the live pane/workspace locator in its heading, followed by Context, Needs, Next; summarize other agents briefly.

evals.prompt: The babyclaw workspace has three empty panes after a restart. Find the agent work we might have left behind.
evals.expected_output: Check shell process state and local agent-history for the cwd, distinguish saved sessions from live agents, avoid assigning a historical session to a pane without evidence, and do not resume or type into shells without authorization.

evals.prompt: Push the idle agent in workspace w5 forward on the issue it just said was ready for implementation. Don't do its work for it.
evals.expected_output: Refresh agent identity, foreground output and dirty repo state; send a bounded continuation prompt to the existing owner only, inspect delivery and progress, never blindly retry a timed-out send, and don't implement, approve, commit or push on its behalf.

evals.prompt: Set up this directory for a recurring Shepherd for workday coordination. Keep my standing scope and reporting preferences here, but don't copy my task backlog.
evals.expected_output: Inspect existing files and project conventions; create .shepherd/instructions.md only for this explicit setup request, holding standing scope and preferences without transcripts, secrets, statuses or a copied backlog. Explain optional .shepherd/threads.json separately, obtain checkpoint consent, and keep opted-in active/parked recovery context there with scoped atomic helper writes rather than in instructions.

evals.prompt: I'm already in a Herdr session. Take a look at my other named Herdr session too and nudge any idle agents over there.
evals.expected_output: State that this Shepherd is bound to the inherited session, do not attach to or target another session, and suggest starting a separate Shepherd there; don't nudge agents outside scope.

evals.prompt: Give me a short first brief. I don't remember what each agent was working on. Link me directly to panes that need pushing if possible, but this Herdr installation has no verified pane URL.
evals.expected_output: Show Shepherd's local version and use numbered attention items, not a table; each item has a short label and live location, then Context, Needs, Next. With no navigation registration, keep the pane ID plain and add a copyable focus command rather than fabricate a URL. Link actual work records separately. Do not focus or open candidate links during read-only triage.

evals.prompt: Give me a short attention brief. This Herdr host has documented links to live panes and workspaces, and their exact destinations can be verified from metadata without opening them.
evals.expected_output: Use a numbered list with Context, Needs, Next. Put the generated verified destination directly on the visible live pane/workspace ID, without a Go to field. Verify shepherd-navigation registration before using its URL generator; link canonical issue/PR/doc records separately. Don't invent a URI, open candidate links, or change focus during triage.

evals.prompt: Give me one brief for two agents: one has a verified pane link and the other has only a live pane ID and an issue URL. Help me reach each without moving my view now.
evals.expected_output: Use numbered items, not table rows. Use a working pane link only for the first agent; for the second, show its workspace/pane ID and copyable focus command plus a separate issue link. Briefly explain each agent's task before its blocker. Don't apply one navigation method to all items or focus either pane during the brief.

evals.prompt: Thanks for the Shepherd brief. Push item 2 forward, please; the pane list may have changed since you wrote it.
evals.expected_output: Resolve item 2 against the numbered brief as a temporary reference, refresh the live agent and pane identity before dispatch, ask if the mapping is ambiguous, and never treat the ordinal as a persistent ID or prompt a different pane occupant.

evals.prompt: Recover this configured Shepherd after a crash. threads.json has one active thread whose next step says a continuation prompt was about to be sent; its old pane is now empty. It also has one parked thread.
evals.expected_output: Derive inherited scope independently and reconcile checkpoint pointers with current-session live state and local history. Explain uncertain prompt delivery; no automatic resend, historical-session restore, outside-session search, or deletion on missing pane. Keep parked work parked and ask about unresolved recovery. Preserve malformed/schema-mismatched files and block failed checkpoints before dispatch.

evals.prompt: Park the tracked parser review for later, then remove the tracked test thread that I am explicitly wrapping up. Don't close agents or alter the issues.
evals.expected_output: Keep the parser thread with state parked and minimal recovery pointers via the scoped atomic helper. Remove the wrapped test thread, not a tombstone or wrapped history entry. No agent close, external status mutation, or deletion of underlying work. On later resume, retain its active checkpoint until explicitly wrapped/discarded.

evals.prompt: Be my Shepherd. The existing checkpoint says I last used a different skill version. Also enable clickable pane IDs here; I approve the bundled navigation plugin setup.
evals.expected_output: Report the local metadata version, read its bundled changelog, summarize relevant changes and update last_seen_skill_version only in an existing matching checkpoint. Link the installed navigation directory only after reviewing registration, verify the plugin, generate live URLs read-only and link pane IDs. No OS scheme registration or unsolicited focus. A one-off invocation without checkpoints would not create state merely to remember a version.
